verdict.rationale: mise is a local command-line tool ('Dev tools, env vars, and tasks in one CLI'), so there is no separate graphical UI whose capabilities an API could match. Probes found no OpenAPI or REST API. The MCP server exposes only a subset (inspect, run tasks) and is a different capability, so it does not create a UI-versus-API parity axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
